text: Leakage: seat leakage class IV per IEC 60534-4 for control valves, class V or VI (bubble-tight) for tight shutoff, isolation and SIS valves; SIS shutdown valves are tight shutoff and fire safe, with partial stroke testing and a fail-safe spring return in the safe direction. Fugitive emission from stems for fuel gas services shall be tested per ISO 15848-1 class B or better.
